offering_description.value: Operates full-service casual dining restaurants with an in-house brewery heritage, serving craft beer, deep-dish pizza and a broad menu to individual guests. Also sells takeout, delivery and catering. Restaurants are company-owned, mostly in leased locations.

primary_products.value: prepared meals; deep-dish pizza; craft beer; other alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages; desserts

primary_services.value: full-service restaurant dining; takeout and delivery; catering; banquet and event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, groups and individual diners, casual dining guests

end_markets.value: casual dining restaurants; food and beverage hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverage sales to dine-in, takeout and delivery guests; service fees: catering and event services; other: gift card sales

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys food, beverage and supplies from suppliers, sells prepared meals to consumers in own restaurants; asset operator: owns and operates company-run restaurants and brewery operations

geography_served.value: US national: Restaurants in about 30 states, concentrated in California, Texas, Florida and Ohio

specialization.value: niche specialist: casual dining restaurants with brewery and pizza focus

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants and brewery restaurants; online: online and app ordering for takeout and delivery; partners / resellers: third-party delivery platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food safety, alcohol licensing, labor and wage rules, local health departments, state alcohol agencies, FDA

notes: Restaurant count and state footprint are approximate.
